title: Fantastic News for Broadcom Stock Investors - Yahoo Finance
snippet: # Fantastic News for Broadcom Stock Investors. **Broadcom** (NASDAQ:AVGO) started the year on a strong note, with its shares rising significantly through the first six months of 2026 and reaching a 52-week high of $495. However, the semiconductor stock has dropped 27% from those levels and is up just 4% year to date, well below the **S&P 500**'s 11% gains. Despite appearances, Broadcom has a lot going for it, and the company's most recent update suggests the market may be underestimating its prospects, making it a particularly attractive stock at current levels. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.* ***Continue »***. 2, Broadcom released its financial results for the third quarter of its fiscal year 2026, which ended Aug. 2. The *Motley Fool Stock Advisor* analyst team just identified what they believe are the **10 best stocks** for investors to buy now… and Broadcom wasn't one of them.
